title: Mixed Event — First Star After the Rain — Episode6 Twilight Rain

meta.Event Outline: Saki has formed a band with her childhood friends and is enjoying what each day brings. She happens upon a poster for an observatory event one day and decides to plan a visit with her bandmates, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But there's no point in going to the observatory now. We wouldn't be able to see anything with this weather.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Saki, breakfast is ready. There's even that hot chocolate you like. Why not come down?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (He took a day off from his job to look after me.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry, I don't feel like eating right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: No? Well, if you get hungry, come downstairs and I'll fix up something for you anytime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I get to be with everyone, so I should be happy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I wanted to see the stars so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
If I go over there, I can see the stars.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There's nobody here...
Maybe they went to the rooftop?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're wearing PJs today?
That's a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, there's a reason for this...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is it also the reason why you came here on your own?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can read me like a book...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You overestimate me.
There's still much I don't know about you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I could see that you weren't your usual self.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would you like to tell me what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you see, it's all my fault...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I insisted on going to the observatory together, but then I became careless and caught a cold. In the end, I just became a bother to everyone...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I've been blaming myself for this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why did you push yourself like that, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As Shiho said, you could go to the observatory some other time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been wanting to spend a day out with my friends like that for such a long time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nice to go and visit, but what if she has gotten worse and is still cooped up in bed?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then we'll just pop in to say hi and leave her to rest.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think she's feeling very lonely today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She was so obsessed with going out today that she got herself sick. I think Ichika understands best.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is just a hunch, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something she said a while ago has been nagging at me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We visited her together once a little after she was admitted to the hospital, remember?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Yeah, it was a really long way to her hospital.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Her mom said they took her there to see a famous doctor specializing in her condition.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I went to visit her several times after that with her mom.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I remember during one of our conversations...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whaaat, our teacher's having a baby?!
Wow, that's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I need to write a letter and congratulate her!
Do you mind taking it to her, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! Now, where did I put my stationery...? Here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I should write to Hona and Shiho too!
Letters feel much more personal than texts.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They seem so busy lately, and haven't been replying to my messages as much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah... They have a lot going on.
Maybe we can visit you together soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... I'll draw pictures of them, too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I was just thinking...
You get to go home and see everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wish I could see them, too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha, gotcha!
I can't let this rain get me down...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“...don't forget to write back!”
There, finished!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona might write back, but I wonder if Shiho will bother? Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, here you go. Thank you for doing this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She must have been much lonelier than we realized.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So I think she'd be happy if we visited her together now.
